mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_history (requestor_id, export_type, scope, status, progress_pct) VALUES (#{requestorId}, #{exportType}, #{scope}::jsonb, COALESCE(#{status},'PROCESSING'), COALESCE(#{progressPct},0))
mapper.update: UPDATE export_history SET file_path = #{filePath}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, row_count = #{rowCount}, status = #{status}, progress_pct = #{progressPct}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, completed_at = #{completedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE export_history SET progress_pct = #{progressPct} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, requestor_id, export_type, scope::text AS scope, file_path, size_bytes, row_count, status, progress_pct, error_message, requested_at, completed_at, expires_at FROM export_history WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, requestor_id, export_type, scope::text AS scope, file_path, size_bytes, row_count, status, progress_pct, error_message, requested_at, completed_at, expires_at FROM export_history WHERE requestor_id = #{requestorId} AND status = #{status} ORDER BY requested_at DESC
